story.setup: Matan asks the guest to talk about why there are so few Ethiopian-Israeli business owners.
story.stakes: A sensitive stereotype and a social question.
story.progression: The guest says it is about the environment and the self-image of the community; extra employees and fewer entrepreneurs; the sentence 'she is not good enough, you must stay here'; racism; a pop-up illustration of a teenager who is told 'you will not succeed'; Matan says he was a friend and that 'you too are stuck on stereotypes'; the brain graphic with labels; the guest says racism exists there too; Matan shows his trip to Ethiopia.
story.payoff: A view that environment and stereotypes shape the gap, with Matan's Ethiopia clip as a personal link; the full discussion is offered through the keyword.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: the clip gives a view and offers the full episode
friction_points: t=15-20 s: a generated-style illustration of a teenager standing alone with the word 'גזענות' may feel heavy or stereotypical (interpretation)
t=6-8 s: the captions put the label 'שכירים' and 'יזמים' on a whole community (interpretation: may provoke the criticism seen in comments)

engagement.comment_notes: Approximate hand count over 45 sampled comments plus replies. About 24 of 45 are the single word 'אני' (the requested keyword; one is the creator's own pinned-style comment of the call). The rest mostly criticise the framing ('אין בעלי עסקים אתיופים? ... זה שלא ראית לא אומר'), with some from Ethiopian-Israeli commenters saying many succeed; a few agree about self-image. Not representative of 490 comments.
